simple.meaning: עָוַר (ʻâvar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to blind.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, Jeremiah, beginning at Exodus 23:8. Its contexts include family line, death, righteousness, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָוַר (H5786).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָוַר (ʻâvar) / H5786 is traced through Exodus 23:8, Deuteronomy 16:19, 2 Kings 25:7, Jeremiah 39:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

majorEvents.label: Death
majorEvents.evidenceText: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

timeline.evidenceText: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

definitions.full: H5786. avar [ עָוַר ] verb Pi`el make blind, blind (original meaning of √ dubious; Thes עור = dig (Arabic etc. cave ); Hal RŠJ xi, 67 compare עוֺר skin , whence blindness as cataract; — Aramaic adjective עֲוִיר , blind , Pa`el עַוַּר , = Hebrew Pi`el; Arabic be one-eyed , Ethiopic be blind Di 995 ); — Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular עִוֵּר 2Kin 25:7 , with עֵינֵי put out the eyes of = Jer 39:7 = 52:11 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְעַוֵּר figurative, Exod 23:8 (E) a bribe blindeth , with accusative of person ( ᵐ5 ⅏ insert עֵינֵי ); Deut 16:19 , with עֵינֵי .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (rather denominatively from 5785 through the idea of a film over the eyes);
